semiconductor_relevance: High — CLEAN ACT provides specialized equipment for critical processes in semiconductor manufacturing, particularly for compound semiconductors.
summary: CLEAN ACT specializes in advanced equipment and process technologies for the semiconductor industry, focusing on dry exhaust gas treatment systems for high-brightness LED and laser diode compound semiconductors. They also offer catalytic combustion systems for managing NH3 emissions in GaN processing and atmospheric pressure CVD systems for improved film thickness uniformity.
capabilities: Dry exhaust gas treatment systems for hazardous gases like AsH3 and PH3
Catalytic combustion exhaust gas treatment systems for high-flow NH3 emissions
Atmospheric pressure CVD systems with face-down method for film uniformity
Customization options for wafer sizes, primarily 8 inches and 6 inches
